comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I'm inclined to think it's the refined Unlock effect as Destry suggested. Consider this JP list of skills:

cgi2.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/start/manual/chap20-001.htm

If you compare Fatigue Recovery with Discovery with Search skill's refined effect from that same page, they have pretty much an identical match. Unlock is about the same. I can definitely confirm that Unlock, when refined, gives increased goods when you open dungeon treasure chests (one friend suggests MA items seemed to become more plentiful in addition to trade goods).
